flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8790 then Make sure a goal map is showing (if none exists, @v16:"create one called 'Run a marathon' via the goal picker '+ New'").
Note the steps in the route list.
Click a milestone in the middle of the route and block it.
Verify the route list changes so the blocked milestone is no longer in it, or the app says no route is possible.
